name: Tart Cherry
dosage_description: Once-daily dose with a glass of water or as advised by the physician. At least 3 months repeated course is feasible as advised by the physician.
side_effects_description: Generally well-tolerated in the recommended dose. Occasionally may cause gastrointestinal discomfort
pregnancy_and_lactation_description: Avoid during pregnancy and lactation due to insufficient data.
storage_conditions_description: Do not store above 30°C. Store away from light & moisture. Keep out of reach of children.
